name: Anehara Princess
source:
I'm now totally confused... I've suddenly become the king?! Also, the girls I make pregnant will become my wives...? Is it true? But Riko, a daughter of the previous king, and Viola, a princess of the neighboring country, actively approach me... As a matter of fact, I'm in love with Yoko. I'll have to make Yoko pregnant while I escape their approaches. Any good ideas...? If Yoko gives birth to a boy, and Riko and Viola give birth to a girl, everything will be ok.... Yoko doesn't know the details, so she might refuse to have sex with me...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
我现在彻底糊涂了…我竟然突然成了国王？！而且，被我弄怀孕的女孩都会成为我的妻子…？这是真的吗？可是前任国王的女儿Riko和邻国公主Viola都在主动接近我…事实上，我爱的人是Yoko。我必须一边躲避她们的追求，一边让Yoko怀孕。有什么好办法吗…？如果Yoko生下男孩，而Riko和Viola生下女孩，一切就都能顺利解决…Yoko不知道事情的来龙去脉，所以可能会拒绝和我发生关系…

[摘自ErogeShop]
